Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly applied a complex and unnecessary formula involving "effective water mass" and mass fractions. The problem is a straightforward application of the Law of Conservation of Mass: the total mass of a mixture is simply the sum of the masses of its components. The correct calculation is $25 \text{ g (salt)} + 1000 \text{ g (water)} = 1025 \text{ g}$. The Planner's logic led to the wrong answer of 1000 g (Option B) by erroneously subtracting the solute mass before adding it back, rather than just adding the two masses directly.
